x = int(input())
y = int(input())
n = int(input())

a = 0  # numerator of the fraction
b = 1  # denominator of the fraction

def compare(dn, i):
    global a, b
    s1 = abs((b * y) * ((x * i) - (y * dn)))
    s2 = abs((y * i) * ((b * x) - (a * y)))
    if s1 < s2 or (s1 == s2 and i < b):
        a = dn
        b = i

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    d1 = (i * x) // y
    d2 = d1 + 1
    compare(d1, i)
    compare(d2, i)

print(f"{a}/{b}")
